name: nimbus-tests
description: Bateria de testes automatizados do Nimbus (backend integration + jornadas)

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:db
scripts.test:repasse: node scripts/unit.mjs repasse && vitest run -c vitest.integration.config.mjs repasse
scripts.test:scraper: node scripts/unit.mjs scraper scrap-tester ml- image-quality
scripts.test:billing: node scripts/unit.mjs billing plan-enforce && vitest run -c vitest.integration.config.mjs billing public-checkout
scripts.test:scheduler: node scripts/unit.mjs scheduler && vitest run -c vitest.integration.config.mjs scheduler manual-ops state
scripts.test:auth: vitest run -c vitest.integration.config.mjs auth email-change emails-security
scripts.test:whatsapp: node scripts/unit.mjs whatsapp && vitest run -c vitest.integration.config.mjs whatsapp
scripts.test:admin: vitest run -c vitest.integration.config.mjs admin store-locks tutoriais
